answer:
Promptfoo 0.123.0 uses the **Responses API** by default for GPT-5.6 and newer models.

The 0.123.0 changelog lists this as a breaking change: "**providers:** default GPT-5.6+ to Responses ([#10803](https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10803))" [promptfoo/0.123.0.md].

The OpenAI provider docs confirm it: "For GPT-5.6 and newer models, use `openai:<model>`, such as `openai:gpt-6-luna`. These IDs default to Responses." [promptfoo/site/docs/providers/openai.md].

To use Chat Completions instead, add an endpoint prefix such as `openai:chat:<model>`. The docs say to "Use `openai:chat:<model>` or `openai:responses:<model>` to select the endpoint explicitly" [promptfoo/site/docs/providers/openai.md].
